# UI.RebindMenu

> Settings screen for rebinding Input keys.

- Package: `UI.RebindMenu` · Category: Client UI
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Input](Input.md), [Theme](Theme.md), [UI.Components](UI.Components.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("UI.RebindMenu")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("UI.RebindMenu")` (shared/client keys)

## `Gaxia.UI.RebindMenu`

- Runs: **client only (LocalScript / client ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Client/UI/RebindMenu.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local RebindMenu = Gaxia.UI.RebindMenu
```

### Functions

- `RebindMenu.KeyName(key: (RebindKey | EnumItem)?): string`
  PURE: friendly display name for a bound key (KeyCode or UserInputType).
- `RebindMenu.CaptureNext(onCaptured: (key: RebindKey?, cancelled: boolean) -> ()): () -> ()`
  Listen for the next key / mouse / gamepad-button press; Esc cancels. Returns a cancel function. onCaptured(key, cancelled) fires exactly once; key is nil when cancelled.
- `RebindMenu.Build(opts: BuildOpts?): RebindHandle`
